overview_description.description:
Causal build financial models effortlessly and share them with interactive, visual dashboards that everyone will understand.

Causal, build models out of variables, that link together in simple plain-English formulae. This makes the models easy to understand and quick to build.

Causal makes it simple to incorporate advanced modeling techniques like scenario analysis, sensitivity analysis, and uncertainty in the inputs.

It can also integrate all the important data sources, from spreadsheet software like Sheets and Excel, to accounting platforms like Xero and Quickbooks.

about_short_description.short_description: Causal is a business planning platform that focuses on visualizing data and financial modeling.

product.name: Causal for Reporting
product.description: A tool that connects to accounting systems to import historical financial data and enables detailed transaction drill-down for financial reporting.

product.name: Causal for SaaS Metrics
product.description: A service that connects to Stripe to provide customizable SaaS metrics, including ARR reporting and customer activity notifications.

product.name: Causal for Forecasting
product.description: A financial forecasting tool that uses templates and customizable models to create detailed business forecasts and scenario plans.

product.name: Causal for Hiring Plans
product.description: A tool to model the financial impact of current and planned hires on a company’s budget and runway using customizable hiring scenarios.

product.name: Causal for Consolidation
product.description: A service that consolidates financial data from multiple entities, performing currency conversion and aggregation to provide a unified business overview.
